===== VERSIONS =====
Ruby:   ruby 3.4.10 (2026-06-30 revision 2b0b7728dc) +PRISM [x86_64-linux]
Node:   v24.9.0
Yarn:   4.13.0
Postgres: PostgreSQL 14.24 (Ubuntu 14.24-0ubuntu0.22.04.1) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu
Docker: Docker version 29.7.2, build a7dcaa6
Rails:  Rails 8.1.3.1

===== POSTGRES CLUSTER =====
14  main    5432 online postgres /var/lib/postgresql/14/main /var/log/postgresql/postgresql-14-main.log

===== DOCKER DEPENDENCY SERVICES =====
NAMES                     STATUS                        PORTS
workspace-apache-tika-1   Up About a minute             0.0.0.0:9998->9998/tcp, [::]:9998->9998/tcp
workspace-mailpit-1       Up About a minute (healthy)   0.0.0.0:1025->1025/tcp, [::]:1025->1025/tcp, 0.0.0.0:8025->8025/tcp, [::]:8025->8025/tcp, 1110/tcp

===== APP PROCESSES =====
18481    foreman: main  
18485    puma 7.2.1 (tcp://localhost:3000) [workspace]
18486    node /usr/local/bin/yarn vite --mode
18505    /opt/downloads/node-v24.9.0-linux-x64/bin/node /workspace/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js --mode development

observation.command:
echo "===== VERSIONS ====="
echo -n "Ruby:   "; /opt/tools/ruby-3.4.10/bin/ruby -v
echo -n "Node:   "; /opt/tools/node-v24.9.0/bin/node -v
echo -n "Yarn:   "; yarn --version 2>/dev/null
echo -n "Postgres: "; su postgres -c "psql -tAc 'SELECT version();'" | cut -d, -f1
echo -n "Docker: "; docker -v
echo -n "Rails:  "; export PATH="/opt/tools/ruby-3.4.10/bin:$PATH"; (bundle exec rails -v 2>/dev/null || true)
echo ""
echo "===== POSTGRES CLUSTER ====="
pg_lsclusters | sed -n '2p'
echo ""
echo "===== DOCKER DEPENDENCY SERVICES ====="
docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}'
echo ""
echo "===== APP PROCESSES ====="
ps aux | grep -E "foreman|vite|puma|rails" | grep -v grep | awk '{printf "%-8s %s %s %s %s\n", $2, $11, $12, $13, $14}'
echo ""
echo "===== HTTP CHECKS ====="
echo -n "GET / (redirect):  "; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" http://localhost:3000/
echo -n "GET /users/sign-in: "; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/users/sign-in
echo -n "GET /home/show (authed session): "; curl -sS -b /tmp/cj2.txt -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/
